identity.title: [v0.92.1][AWS][runtime-v3] Cut warm Polis GPU startup with prebuilt artifacts and persistent EBS

review_prompts: Can normal launch reach any compiler package manager Git mutable download or model pull path?
Can Terraform destroy or a trap delete the persistent warm volumes?
Are timing denominators complete and comparable?
Can stale or cross-AZ volume content activate?
Are #605 SSH private-Ollama IAM and cleanup invariants preserved?

findings.summary: Interrupted completion can create duplicate retained sealed snapshots and an unreferenced temporary restore while understating cost.
Resume does not fully bind checkout, state, plans, artifacts, ledger, and consumed authorization to the original exact campaign.
Permanent AWS API errors are retried forever instead of failing while only healthy transitional resource states wait indefinitely.
Preservation starts after both create-image calls, leaving an interruption window that destroys a partially created image and makes the consumed run non-resumable.
Tests do not execute resume rejection, idempotence, permanent API failure, preservation, and cost accuracy, and retained SOR validation is stale.

residual_risk: The available prepared AMIs and completed root snapshots remain preserved while remediation and fresh review proceed.
